title: Momentum-Space Scarring on Irrational Point-Scatterer Tori
exact_target: Determine whether some high-energy eigenfunctions of an irrational point-scatterer torus concentrate in momentum directions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001877 (OWR-11135-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
The Analytic Theory of Automorphic Forms (2011), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2011/43, pp. 2397--2458; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 41--42, printed pages 2437--2438.

status_qualification: The primary report states a conditional positive result assuming Poisson spacing of the unperturbed eigenvalues. The unconstrained catalogue question omits the irrationality and coupling details needed for a full theorem; this preparation does not certify that no later unconditional result exists.
